scope: Actual agentctl Native/registry/AgentStore/test.run resident output off/on; scripted model choices

rows.actions: scripted Native-parser choices; real agentctl/tool execution

method.residency: one model process; reset session only between independent tasks; no KV save/evict/restore
method.receipt: both off/on body-first then final status footer; default CLI legacy layout unchanged
method.workload: three real test.run calls plus four real Native prepare/first-greedy/actions through CLI REPL and AgentStore; fixed Native-parser tool choices;8 plain lines; actual words/iterations recorded on every row
method.order: Each case/mode1 warmup then7 evaluated tasks; modes rotate by replicate. old=E29; on=E30; thread=old owner no-op; token=old tokenize only; progress=later-output gate. Exact workload on each row.
method.metrics: CLI tick wall including tools, transcript assembly, Native and numeric logs; exact post-token independent tokenizer oracle measured separately and subtracted; raw wall retained
method.excluded: model load, helper first/warm execution, per-task ordinary Native reset; no build optimization

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; real CLI/tool execution, not autonomous model planning or full output generation
Tools bounded retained4096 bytes; test.run(empty args) and verified Qwen3 template only; full render/prefix guard remains
No snapshots, evictions, disk-KV transfer, memory capacity win, cloud SSE or Windows/CUDA acceptance
No evaluation tuning; all warmup/evaluation pairs and negative results retained; per-task reset/model-resident workload only
